abstract: The cytomorphologic observations of ascites from three patients with ovarian dysgerminomas are presented. As compared with those in adenocarcinoma, the cytologic findings in this rare malignant ovarian tumor showed more cells lying isolated or in sheetlike arrangements, fewer cells with discrete cytoplasmic vacuoles, less frequent thickening of the nuclear membrane and more frequent multinucleolation.
abstract_ja: 卵巣未分化胚細胞腫の患者3例の腹水について、細胞形態学的所見を報告する。腺癌と比較すると、本疾患では細胞が孤立性またはシート状に配列する頻度が高く、細胞質空胞が少なく、核膜の肥厚が少なく、核小体の多発がより多く認められた。
